description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 演示时从桌面直接打开的黑板是黑色的，不再是白色（#485）；`Shift+C` 识别文字并复制后，选区旁的小卡片写明复制了什么，点“编辑”可以改（#489）；打码时点一行字稍微滑了几个像素也算点中，选了别的样式再点已经盖住的一行会换成新样式（#499）；公式识别窗口的关闭按钮又有图标了；为避开睡眠唤醒后闲着时偶发的崩溃，界面一次回收内存，不再分步回收（#490）。权限不变。
notes.en: The black board opened straight from the desktop while presenting is black, not white (#485); after `Shift+C` copies the text read, the card beside the selection shows what was copied, with 编辑 (#489); a click on a line of text that slipped a few pixels still hides it, and a hidden line clicked with another style takes that style (#499); the formula window's close button has its icon again; QML collects garbage at once rather than in steps, against a rare crash while idle after sleep (#490). Permissions unchanged.
